name: Palm-nut sweet soup
summary: Chè thốt nốt is a cold bowl of clear palm-nut jelly mixed with coconut cream and shaved ice. Eat it as an afternoon snack or a light dessert.
origin: The thốt nốt palms on the plains around Châu Đốc.
texture: The nut gives a clear jelly, mixed with coconut cream and shaved ice.
howToEat: Order the bowl cold, in the afternoon or after a meal.
The fruit itself, quả thốt nốt, is sold separately as a gift, next to palm sugar.
where: In town, after the market or the hill.
seoTitle: Che thot not in Chau Doc
seoDescription: Chè thốt nốt is clear palm-nut jelly with coconut cream and shaved ice, the cold afternoon sweet of Châu Đốc.
